name: @battuta/plugin-reflection
description: The reflection cycle: shift+R cycles a block through its serial forms — prime, inversion, retrograde, retrograde inversion.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare — nothing to be stale. (core and api build to dist/ because node tooling outside the bundler imports them.)

dependencies: @battuta/api and nothing else of the workspace. @battuta/core is not here and cannot be added — apps/editor/test/plugin-boundaries.test.ts fails the build on it. A plugin that seems to need core is asking for an api addition, not an import.
